parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host whose control policy you want to delete.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the control policy to be deleted.

>  You can call the [ListPolicies](~~2758876~~) operation to query the control policy ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-policy --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
